note: State of every model_version that appears in the prediction ledger. Anything not listed is research. Only the owner changes this file; promotion is disabled in the system (QSDE_ML_PROMOTION_ENABLED=false) and a state change here is a recorded decision, never automatic.

defensive_cards_v1.description: Defensive risk label (five equal-weight percent ranks) and the decision-card allocation built on it. A risk-reduction signal: it makes no return forecast (no probability or expected return is logged). Logged forward, in shadow, to measure whether the ordering helps net of costs.
